title.rendered: The Sherwood Schools 2016 Capital Bond – At a Glance

content.rendered:
As the District moves forward
in development of plans, timelines and completion of bond-related projects,
that information will be shared regularly through this site and other
communication outlets including the monthly District Newsletter, Facebook and
Twitter.  CLICK
HERE for additional information.
